column1: Preheat the oven to 356°F (180°C) and line a baking sheet.
Heat the butter and milk together until the butter melts and the mixture boils.
Add the flour all at once and stir quickly until a smooth dough forms.
Mix in the eggs, then the grated Parmigiano Reggiano, and season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Using a piping bag with a 15 mm plain tip, pipe mounds about 3–4 cm across onto the baking sheet.
